label: For "Visual Defect Inspection": Detect surface and assembly defects on parts moving on a line from camera images, classify the defect type and reject or flag the part before it ships. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on operator rejects as truth.
